who.value: buyer watching a TCG live auction

stage.value: transaction — bidding during a live show

job.value: Watch the lot and bid before the timer runs out

arrivedFrom.value: A Live shows row or a follow notification

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The video, 'Sudden death 5 seconds' lot card with timer '00:02' and 'Bid: S$20' make it plainly a live auction.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The orange 'Bid: S$20' pill at the bottom is the single strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'React', 'Mute', 'Share' and 'Shop' are clear, but 'Set up' (with a red dot) and 'More' don't say what they open.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Sudden death 5 seconds' and 'Top supporters' appear with no explanation for a buyer new to live auctions.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only decision is whether to bid the shown amount, which the buyer can judge from the lot and 'Karen C is winning'.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Show notes and supporters sit behind small 'Show notes' / 'Top supporters' entry points rather than open.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything on screen — chat, lot, bid, follow — belongs to watching and bidding in a show.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: The buyer can bid from 'S$11', '00:02' and 'Bid: S$20' without reading the chat.
